description: Pre-registered MIMIC-IV retrospective study protocol. Freeze before inspecting the temporal holdout. Demo-schema compatible until credentialed access arrives.
disclaimer: Prototype engineering study design — not IRB-approved clinical research, not FDA evidence, not for patient care.

dataset.name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database

demo_fallback.name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo
demo_fallback.role: plumbing / CURIE-015 harness only — never the primary analysis cohort

dataset.access: PhysioNet credentialed download or cloud + signed DUA required for Stage B
dataset.pin_policy: Record exact PhysioNet version string + extract date + content hash of derived stay list at first Stage B extract. Do not change for the primary analysis.

mimic_code.pin_policy: Record git commit SHA + Zenodo release (if any) used for sepsis/AKI derived concepts before label generation. Primary analysis uses that pin only.
planned_concepts: sepsis-3 / suspicion of infection + SOFA delta (adapted)

inclusion: First ICU stay per hospital admission (hadm_id) for primary analysis

exclusions_or_subgroups.comfort_care: subgroup + suppression analysis; not hard-excluded from detection denominator unless chart-confirmed
exclusions_or_subgroups.esrd_on_dialysis: AKI endpoint: exclude from AKI primary denominator; report as subgroup

primary_event.name: sepsis3_onset
primary_event.definition: Sepsis-3-aligned: suspected infection + acute SOFA rise >= 2 from baseline within infection window (mimic-code concept pin)
primary_event.onset_time: availability-time of the observation that first completes the phenotype
primary_event.note: Do not use discharge ICD sepsis codes as primary onset

secondary_events.name: aki_kdigo_stage_ge_1
secondary_events.definition: KDIGO stage >= 1 by creatinine and/or covered UO (align with aki-kdigo v0.4 timeline)

secondary_events.name: respiratory_deterioration_proxy
secondary_events.definition: Exploratory — ventilation escalation or severe hypoxemia per resp-deterioration v0.1; not primary

prediction_cadence.description: Replay FHIR/canonical envelopes in availability-time order; score on each usable observation update (not fixed hourly bins for primary).
prediction_cadence.hourly_sensitivity_analysis: Optional hourly re-bin for Challenge-comparable tables only

availability_time_policy.corrections: Amended/corrected observations replace prior value only at their own availability_time
availability_time_policy.leakage_tests: CURIE-015 automated tests must fail closed if future information is introduced

notes: If the pinned MIMIC-IV version uses a different calendar span, rescale ranges proportionally but keep three temporal roles.
Demo schema maps synthetic stay years into the same split_ids for harness smoke only.

detection_timing.rule: any governed or naive alert with event_time in [onset - 12h, onset + 6h]

primary_endpoint.name: noninferior_governed_sensitivity
primary_endpoint.definition: Among labeled-positive stays, fraction with >=1 true-positive alert inside the primary detection window
primary_endpoint.comparator: naive_sensitivity on the same stays and window

operating_point_selection.rule: On development, sweep governance knobs + page-gate settings with fixed score bundles. On calibration, select the candidate that minimizes interruptive_reduction_ratio subject to PE-1 success_rule. Freeze winner JSON. Never re-select using test.
operating_point_selection.selection_objective: min interruptive_reduction_ratio s.t. PE-1 on calibration

ablations.rule: Ablation configs frozen before test evaluation; report all on test once

missing_data_analyses: sensitivity among partial vs complete scores
component-missing rates for respiration/FiO2 and creatinine/UO
no ambient FiO2 assumption without room_air (C-SAFE-3)

product_claims_evidence_map.claim: Shared alert governance reduces interruptive alert volume vs threshold-only scoring while preserving detection of labeled deterioration within a clinically meaningful window.
Episode arbitration produces one actionable patient episode instead of independent alert floods for concurrent signals.
Adding an indicator is a plugin/bundle task without a new platform path.
Availability-time replay does not use future information.
Clinical validation / FDA clearance / superiority to NEWS/qSOFA / SaMD readiness
required_evidence: explicitly out of scope until Stage C–F

analysis_rules.multiple_comparisons: Primary + co-primary pre-specified; secondaries and subgroups descriptive unless marked confirmatory
